On line 119 of my Financial Disclosure Report for the calendar year 2016 there is an entry relating to an asset labeled FIMM MKT Port Inst. CL. My Year-End

manager that for internal company-wide policy considerations the firm decided to close out the FIMM MMKT Port Inst CL asset in 2017 and transfer any

balances to another Fidelity Money Market asset in my account.
